# Three.js Qixi runtime

This directory contains the Three.js r181 modules used by the Qixi bouquet page.

- Project: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- Release: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r181
- License: `LICENSE.txt` (MIT)

Included modules: `three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`, `GLTFLoader.js`, `MeshSurfaceSampler.js`, and `BufferGeometryUtils.js`. Addon imports were changed only to resolve against this self-hosted flat directory.
